name: E10 Contract Terms
rows: The Owner retains 5% of each progress payment until substantial completion.

The Owner retains 10% of each progress payment. When the Work is more than 50% complete and progress is satisfactory, the Owner may in writing reduce retainage to 5% of the Work completed and stored to date.

Materials stored off the site are paid only with a bill of sale, a certificate of insurance covering the materials at the storage location and naming the Owner, and the Owner's written approval. Materials stored on the site are paid when delivered, with the delivery ticket.
